transformation: Language-indexed inventories from cldf/values.csv, cldf/languages.csv and cldf/contributions.csv at the pinned commit. 3020 inventories over 2186 languages, reshaped from 105,466 one-row-per-segment values into one row per inventory with the segments space-separated, which is the same information at a seventeenth of the size. Language rows keep Glottocode, name, family, macroarea and coordinates; nothing is added, dropped or renamed beyond that reshape.
citation: Moran, Steven & McCloy, Daniel (eds.) 2019. PHOIBLE 2.0. Jena: Max Planck Institute for the Science of Human History. https://phoible.org/
redistribution_notes: Upstream terms are CC-BY-SA-3.0. Redistributed here under CC-BY-4.0 by permission; see `relicensed`, whose grantor and date are not yet recorded. Attribution to PHOIBLE remains required. The share-alike clause was the original reason this layer was a separate package; that reason is gone, and the remaining one -- keeping sampling weight and genealogy out of the core -- is the one that mattered.
sampling_note: Not a balanced sample of the world's languages and never claimed to be. 3020 inventories over 2186 languages, so 834 are additional doculects of a language already present. 176 families, of which Atlantic-Congo 19.4%, Pama-Nyungan 11.6%, Indo-European 6.8% of languages. Any cross-language aggregate computed here is an aggregate over this composition; merkmal_typology attaches it to every such result rather than letting a bare number travel on its own.
generator: derived from the CLDF release; see transformation
